title: G45 Onboarding Branch Analysis
methodology: IDA disassembly + live game log analysis + filesystem inventory + database inspection

evidence_chain.evidence: No player-specific save file exists anywhere on the filesystem
SaveData.json contains only MasterDataVersion + MasterDataFile[] - no player data
$IsTutorialProgress is server-authoritative (read from HTTP response, defaults to 0)
TutorialProgress string has 0 code xrefs in binary
/tutorial/* and /game_data/* were not triggered in G41 live run
UserId=-1 used in local tutorial (G36) but tutorial did not complete server-side

ruled_out_classifications.reason: No persistence source identified - no save file, no DB record, no local config
UserId=-1 is the default value, not a trigger. The game uses IsOnline flag to determine whether to show tutorial, not UserId.
No result value was ever sent to the server (player_progress is empty)

onboarding_state_determination.how_determined: Game checks IsOnline flag (offset 0x64 in struct). If IsOnline=0, game enters SystemDataCheck error path which loops through PromotionMovie → Title → InsertStart. If IsOnline=1 and NESYS card is presented, game proceeds to ReadCard → profile load.
onboarding_state_determination.what_triggers_tutorial: The game's internal state machine in CPP_InsertStartWidget.cpp determines whether to show tutorial based on: (1) IsOnline flag, (2) NESYS card reception, (3) server profile load response. No local persistence involved.
onboarding_state_determination.g36_vs_g44_difference: G36 may have had IsOnline=1 due to different timing/state. G44 had IsOnline=0 because NESYS cert authentication failed (CertError), which prevented the online gate from passing.

UserId_minus_one_effect.description: UserId=-1 is the default/uninitialized value. It does not force first-time flow. The game uses IsOnline (server connectivity flag) to determine flow, not UserId.
UserId_minus_one_effect.evidence: G36 used UserId=-1 and reached tutorial path. G44 used UserId=-1 and did NOT reach tutorial path. The difference was in IsOnline flag state, not UserId.

Result_Timeover_Lose_effect: Not analyzed in G45 - this is a match result value, not related to onboarding.
Result_Withdrawal_effect: Not analyzed in G45 - this is a match result value, not related to onboarding.
